title: Number of Magistrate's Complaints Filed and Proposal for Awareness Campaign on Use of Magistrate's Complaints
what_it_is: Number of Magistrate's Complaints Filed and Proposal for Awareness Campaign on Use of Magistrate's Complaints

sections.label: Magistrate's Complaints and Police investigations
sections.summary: The Courts say the Judiciary's website has resources on filing a Magistrate's Complaint, which is distinct from Police investigations after a Police report.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: The Courts have informed us that there are educational resources available on the Judiciary's website, which members of the public may refer to for information on, amongst other things, when and how they may file a Magistrate's Complaint.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: The hon Member also referred to the relationship between Magistrate's Complaints and Police investigations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: I should clarify that the Magistrate's Complaint process provides a framework for private prosecutions by any person, subject to the assessment of the Magistrate of whether there is sufficient reason for the complaint to proceed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: The process is distinct from criminal investigations conducted by the Police following the filing of a Police report, which do not require the filing of a Magistrate's Complaint.

sections.label: Help filing a Magistrate's Complaint
sections.summary: The Courts describe website resources and assistance for filing a Magistrate's Complaint, including call centre, Service Hub, counter staff, student helpers and interpreters.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: There are resources on the Judiciary's website that cover these.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: There are also resources to support persons who may need assistance in filing a Magistrate's Complaint.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: If there is a difficulty in filing online, the person can call the State Courts' call centre to seek guidance or go to the State Court's Service Hub, or use the terminals in the business centre to file the complaint.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: If the person has difficulty understanding the filing process or instructions in English, he or she can seek help from the counter staff.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: A student under the University Court Friends programme may also be assigned and can also help the person navigate the filing process.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: I would also add, Sir, that in relation to translation issues, the Court website states that when filing a Magistrate's Complaint, the person may indicate their preferred language in the Magistrate's Complaint form and arrangements will be made to assign an interpreter if required.
